title: Week of August 10, 2026
summary: Bandstand season peaks in both towns — the US Army Field Band plays Bethany on Thursday and Rehoboth on Friday — and this week's Hidden Gem is the trail almost everyone drives past on Route 1.

dailySlots.headline: The week ahead on the coast
dailySlots.note: Two Army Field Band dates, a members' social at Cape Henlopen, and markets in Lewes.

dailySlots.headline: Hidden Gem: Thompson Island Nature Preserve
dailySlots.note: A designated Natural Area Preserve you can look at but not walk onto — and why the trail ends where it does.

dailySlots.headline: Bethany's bandstand gets the Army Field Band
dailySlots.note: 7:30 PM at the Bethany Bandstand, free.

dailySlots.headline: The same band, one town north
Market morning in Lewes
dailySlots.note: George H.P. Smith Park, 8 AM to noon — pair it with the canal-to-harbour walk.
